title: Practice 12: до, после, около, мимо, кроме, вместо, против…

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: против — opposite, against. с — from, since. у — by, near, at. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book.
